newsitem.title: USA: Interface Systems sees fiscal Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Interface Systems sees fiscal Q4 loss.

text.p: Interface Systems Inc said Friday it expects to lose about $1.1 million to $1.2 million in the fourth quarter ended September 30, or about $0.24 to $0.27 a share.
The loss would put the company's fiscal 1996 year loss at $1.75 to $1.85 million, or $0.38 to $0.40 a share, Interface said.
Interface said the company's fiscal fourth quarter results were hurt by an unexpected delay in a major order.
Interface, which develops and markets computer hardware and software products, said it now expects a major order of its CLEO line in fiscal 1997. CLEO is a communications software.

"Our quarterly performance was adversely affected by the unexpected delay in the receipt of an anticipated major CLEO order until the 1997 fiscal year," said chairman and interim chief executive G.F. Graber.
Interface said the fourth quarter and year losses are largely a result of investments in the development of the Oasis product line and in sales and marketing.

"These investments did not result in the short-term revenues necessary to avoid a loss," Graber said. "We are continuing to analyze all our activities and are undertaking programs to reduce our operating costs."
Interface said, however, it enhanced the existing Oasis line, resulting in the first $100,000 sale of that product.
